column6: Sigmoid Analytics Round: 2 - Online Test - DE Intern, SDE Intern
column10: About Sigmoid:      Sigmoid enables business transformation using data and analytics, leveraging real-time decisions through insights, by building modern data architectures using cloud and open source. Some of the world’s largest Fortune 1000 data producers engage with Sigmoid to solve complex business problems. Sigmoid brings deep expertise in data engineering, predictive analytics, AI/ML, and DataOps. Your Role at Sigmoid: We are seeking talented, motivated students to join our internship program with the opportunity for full-time employment upon successful completion of training. This role offers exposure to both Data Engineering and Software Engineering domains, with final specialization determined based on your aptitude and business requirements during the training period. Ideal candidates are currently pursuing or have recently completed a Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field. You should have strong programming fundamentals in at least one language such  as Python, Java, JavaScript, C++, or Scala, along with a solid understanding of data structures and algorithms. A good grasp of database concepts and SQL, familiarity  with the software development lifecycle, testing methodologies, and version control systems like Git is expected. We value strong analytical and problem-solving skills,  effective communication, and the ability to work collaboratively within a team. You  should be a self-starter with a keen eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving requirements. This role also involves interfacing with enterprise customers, including leading Fortune 500 companies, to understand their strategic priorities and contribute to aligning Sigmoid solutions with their business goals. A high degree of ownership, initiative, and customer-centric thinking is key to succeeding in this role.      What You'll Do During Training Phase:      • Participate in comprehensive technical training covering both data and software  engineering fundamentals  • Work on hands-on projects spanning data pipelines, analytics, and software  development • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on real client projects  • Attend workshops, mentoring sessions, and technical skill development programs      Post-Training Opportunities:      Data Engineering Track:  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes  Work with big data technologies and cloud platforms to process large datasets  • Implement data quality frameworks and monitoring systems  • Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to support analytics initiatives  • Optimize data storage solutions and ensure data governance compliance Software Engineering Track:  • Develop web applications, mobile apps, and enterprise software solutions  • Build APIs, microservices, and distributed systems  • Work on frontend and backend development using modern frameworks  • Implement CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices  • Contribute to product architecture and technical decision-making      2 years 6 months service bond applicable post internship upon successful conversion.

See yourself at Twilio -        Join the team as our next Software Engineering intern    Who we are & why we’re hiring       Twilio powers real-time business communications and data solutions that help companies and developers worldwide build better applications and customer experiences.    Although we're headquartered in San Francisco, we're on a journey to becoming a globally antiracist company that supports diversity, equity & inclusion wherever we do business. We employ thousands of Twilions worldwide, and we're looking for more builders, creators, and visionaries to help fuel our growth momentum.    About the job       You will be responsible for carrying out simple but reliable deployments and handle basic maintenance tasks with guidance of senior team members.     You will monitor the health and performance of services, using metric logging and telemetry systems to identify and resolve issues.     You will adhere to coding standards and best practices with the support of your manager and mentor.    You will take part in code reviews, bug tracking, team project planning and goal setting.     You will participate actively in team discussions across all stages of the development life cycle, sharing insights and demonstrating learnings from experienced engineers.     You will demonstrate consistent improvement in your coding skills, issue-tracking and source control systems, and agile development mentality.    You will demonstrate a basic understanding of software development processes, including stand-up, backlog refinement, planned and retro meetings.     You will seek feedback and guidance, working together to address and resolve customer needs.     About you       - Demonstrates fundamental Computer Science knowledge (i.e. proficiency in 1+ programming languages, core data structures, algorithms, operating systems, common network protocols and testing).    - Knowledge of processes and engineering best practices in all phases of the software development life-cycle.     - At least one 8-weeks internship experience as a Software Engineer intern.     - Experience working with Java frameworks such as Dropwizard, Spring, Hibernate, or similar, either in an academic, internship or professional environments.    - Strong communication skills and desire to make an impact and thrive in a collaborative environment.    - Ability to write clean, maintainable and efficient code.    - Knowledge and exposure to modern testing frameworks.    - Knowledge and exposure of Agile methodologies.           What We Offer    There are many benefits to working at Twilio, including, in addition to competitive pay, things like generous time-off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more.
